mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, main_id, type, param_json, message, return_json
mapper.select: SELECT sbe.type,COUNT ( 1 ) AS typeCount FROM so_b2c_error sbe left join so_b2c sb2c on sbe.main_id = sb2c.id WHERE sbe.main_id != '' and sb2c.is_deleted = false and sb2c.approve_status = 'approve' AND sbe.type IN ( 'getLogisticsCode', 'submitDelivery', 'orderForecast', 'generateTransferInfo', 'virtualFreezeQty', 'generateOutstock', 'signDelivery' ) GROUP BY sbe.type

SELECT sb2c.sign_order_error as type, COUNT (1) AS typeCount FROM so_b2c sb2c INNER JOIN so_b2c_logistics sb2cl ON sb2c.ID = sb2cl.main_id AND sb2cl.is_deleted =FALSE INNER JOIN so_b2c_receiver sb2cr ON sb2c.ID = sb2cr.main_id AND sb2cr.is_deleted =FALSE INNER JOIN shop_info si ON sb2c.shop_id = si.ID AND si.is_deleted =FALSE LEFT JOIN so_b2c_delivery sbd ON sbd.source_id = sb2c.ID AND sb2c.is_deleted = FALSE AND sbd.status != 'cancelDelivery' WHERE sb2c.is_deleted = FALSE AND sb2c.sign_order_error != '' AND sb2c.invalid_status = FALSE AND sb2c.pay_status IN ( 'paid' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM so_b2c_detail sbd WHERE sbd.is_deleted = FALSE AND sbd.main_id = sb2c.ID ) AND sb2c.shop_id IN ( SELECT ID FROM shop_info WHERE is_deleted = FALSE )
AND sb2c.sign_order_error IN
#{item}
GROUP BY sb2c.sign_order_error ORDER BY typeCount DESC

select sbe.id as errorIds, sbe.type, sbe.message, sbe.code, sb2c.dict_platform as dictPlatform from so_b2c_error sbe inner join so_b2c sb2c on sb2c.is_deleted = false and sb2c.id = sbe.main_id where sbe.id in (select max(id) from so_b2c_error GROUP BY main_id,type) and sbe.type in ('signDelivery','getLogisticsCode','orderForecast','thirdWarehouseOutException')
